title: E-FRC-0065: the charged-lepton Koide relation does not extend to the neutrinos: with the measured mass-squared...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0065 in the gauge arena: the charged-lepton Koide relation does not extend to the neutrinos: with the measured mass-squared splittings the neutrino Koide Q maxes at 0.584 (normal) and 0.500 (inverted), both below 2/3 and unreachable with positive roots, so the mechanism is charged-lepton specific and the neutrino sector needs different structure, completing the scope audit begun for the quarks.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
